name: token-monitor-embedded
description: Local Codex token telemetry in an automatically opened embedded panel.

interface.shortDescription: Local token monitor inside a conversation panel
interface.longDescription: Local token usage, per-call API-equivalent cost, thread input/output and reasoning totals, cache status, allowances, compaction, history, and tool attribution. Opens once per local chat through a first-prompt instruction; refreshes directly without model turns.
